title: Client's Bold Mercedes S63 Partial Wrap
description: At Vinyl Wrap Toronto, we specialize in vinyl installation. Our recent project featured a Mercedes S63 partial wrap. For more details, visit our blog!

blocks.text: Client’s Bold Mercedes S63 Partial Wrap

blocks.alt: Side-angle view of a Mercedes S63 displaying the Black Carbon car roof

blocks.html:
Our team of designers recently completed a Mercedes S63 partial wrap for a client. The roof was wrapped in black carbon fiber, a lightweight material that enhances the vehicle’s performance and ensures a smoother ride. For more details, check out the information below!

Close-up angle of a Mercedes S63 displaying Black Carbon Car roof

Mercedes S63 Partial Wrap Project Insights

A thank you to the talented designers at Branding Centres for their exceptional work on the installation!

We used Wrap Authority for the design template, it was printed on a 1080 Series IJ 180 Printable Vinyl with Gloss Finish
